YOUR GARDEN, YOUR DATA

Settings.

Nothing here needs an account or a cloud.

✎

Garden name

Give this garden a name. It appears in the header and is included in new ZIP backups. This does not rename the app, origin, or local database.

The app is still Verdant; only your garden’s display name changes.

◫

Map & calibration

Import a cropped, georeferenced GeoTIFF (EPSG:25830 recommended), or keep the manual screenshot workflow. Marker coordinates never change when replacing a map.

↧

Back up & restore

Backups include records, photos, and your map. Restore replaces the current garden; your API key stays on this device.

More options

Recover broken photos from the original ZIP without replacing garden records.

On iPhone, copy the ZIP into Files → On My iPhone if needed. For emergency recovery, use the rescue utility. Never clear site storage.

▣

Photo optimization

Compress new journal photos locally before saving them. The original photo is used for identification first. Your aerial map is never compressed.

Targets are approximate. Already-small photos stay unchanged. Bulk optimization runs in Settings and requires a verified backup because reducing image quality cannot be undone.

✺

Pl@ntNet identification

Search species and identify up to five photos online, with your own API key. Identification is optional; your inventory stays usable offline.

No key configured.
Create account ↗API key settings ↗

Enable “expose my API key” and authorize this exact origin in Pl@ntNet's settings: . Your key is stored on this device, not in backups. Browser profile access can expose it.

⌂

Offline & storage

This app caches its files to work without a server after the initial load. Photos and records live in IndexedDB. Safari may deny storage protection automatically; this does not block saving. Keep downloaded ZIP backups.

Checking storage…
!

Reset entire application

Erase every plant, type, journal, map, photo, calibration, Pl@ntNet key and offline cache. This is irreversible. Uninstalling the home-screen icon remains a separate device action.
